items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Billy Butler put me in charge I can't think of the name. ... So I'm in charge of time, I'm in charge of the payroll, writing these things down.

ctx.x: arrange that. You got to get off. What the hell, we can arrange that. No problem. So I worked for him about three months. We had a terrific group.
Was it after that, because I'm a little confused in time now, wasn't it somewhere in there after this that Billy Butler got you to, for the Ethel Waters Show.
Yes, it was around that time.
